teams.blurb: Top of both halves of the formula: Win-Now #1 and Dynasty #2. The 16-3-1 record comes with the #1 points total and a 69-20 all-play mark; the rest-of-season projection ranks #1, the best in the league. Jahmyr Gibbs, Malik Nabers and Matthew Golden lead the roster value; it's one of the two youngest cores in the league by value.

The roster carries this ranking: Dynasty #1, built on Ja'Marr Chase, Brock Bowers and Jordan Love, outweighs a Win-Now rank of only #5. The 9-11 record comes with the #2 points total and a 51-39 all-play mark, so the record undersells the team; the rest-of-season projection ranks #5. Jeremiyah Love and Davante Adams are out or on IR, which drags the projection; the Week 9 trade for Derrick Henry and 2027 R2 (Taylor's) is already priced in.

The roster carries this ranking: Dynasty #3, built on Josh Allen, CeeDee Lamb and Trey McBride, outweighs a Win-Now rank of only #6. The 9-10-1 record comes with the #3 points total and a 49-40 all-play mark; the rest-of-season projection ranks #7. Ty Simpson is out or on IR, which drags the projection.
